nodes.label: How should the six historically distinct multilingual/agent research programs be revalidated and developed without collapsing their mechanisms or inheriting legacy lifecycle claims?

data.controller_boundary: This intake registers separate program authorities. It does not promote any historical stage, gate, claim, source interpretation, or child result.
data.history_policy: Legacy branches remain visible as read-only provenance inputs; they never inherit authority into a v2 child.
data.posterior_review_boundary: This derived portfolio summary does not establish novelty, replace child artifacts, pass a gate, choose a route, or mutate any child lifecycle.

data.surviving_boundary: A narrower, testable boundary remains: a revision-pinned long-horizon factorial crossing query, schema, parameter-value, and evaluator languages while holding intent and execution semantics fixed, with both executable and independent semantic adjudication.
next_evidence: Build one paired factorial trace set before any route decision.
Pre-register which trace fields distinguish semantic selection from representation and evaluator effects.
data.owner_review_boundary: Portfolio summary is navigation only; the owner input must be recorded in the child collision-review Note.

data.surviving_boundary: The only defensible candidate boundary is a paired language-switch replay that snapshots task state and separately logs language selection, retrieval, locale assets, flow routing, and independent action adjudication.
next_evidence: Acquire at least one paired real or benchmark trace containing both state snapshots and language-control variables.
Do not route until the trace can discriminate memory loss from intact-state rerouting.
data.owner_review_boundary: Portfolio summary is navigation only; the owner input must be recorded in the child collision-review Note.

data.surviving_boundary: A candidate boundary survives only as a controlled paired commit task where language alone varies and comprehension, translation, tool contract, and text-safety refusal are separately measured.
next_evidence: Acquire or construct one deterministic paired commit trace with explicit authorization state.
Do not route until an authorization-specific effect survives comprehension and translation controls.
data.owner_review_boundary: Portfolio summary is navigation only; the owner input must be recorded in the child collision-review Note.

data.surviving_boundary: The defensible remainder is a transport test of a fixed routing/feedback policy across natural errors, at least two use cases and language pairs, with rater disagreement and presentation explicitly modeled.
next_evidence: Define the decision loss and human-review reference before selecting a threshold.
Run a small natural-error transport check before any proposal route.
data.owner_review_boundary: Portfolio summary is navigation only; the owner input must be recorded in the child collision-review Note.

data.surviving_boundary: A narrower boundary remains: identify the minimal revision-pinned execution-contract fields whose controlled change reverses a comparison, and require trace evidence that attributes the reversal without treating diagnostic symptoms as causes.
next_evidence: Construct one pinned pair differing in exactly one declared contract field.
Test whether independent replay and adjudication agree on the first causal divergence.
data.owner_review_boundary: Portfolio summary is navigation only; the owner input must be recorded in the child collision-review Note.

data.surviving_boundary: The surviving question must be causal and minimal: which preserved object—failed branch, source locator, belief update, or route reversal—changes an independent scientific decision or source-grounded human understanding under matched time and artifact budgets?
next_evidence: Test one preserved object at a time against output-only review under a matched budget.
Measure decision reversal or source-grounded reconstruction, not preference for transparency.
